opportunities.title: Research and Travel Grants – Research Awards (Hugh Phillips, Margaret and Tom Jones, Wainwright Research Archaeology in Wales, Open Research)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Awards will not be made for work contributing to an undergraduate or postgraduate degree. Retrospective applications will not be considered. Early career researchers welcome. Named awards include Marion Wilson Awards (southern Britain), Joan Pye Awards (early-career researchers within five years of PhD, prehistoric and Roman archaeology in the UK), Hugh Chapman Memorial Awards (Western Roman Empire or antiquarian matters in London).
opportunities.summary: Annual project grants of £500 to £5,000 to support research into the human past through its material culture or material remains, with no period, geographic or disciplinary restrictions. Covers archaeology, art history, architectural and buildings history, material culture studies, history of collecting, and intellectual enquiry into the human past. Awards made annually with possible renewal up to two further years (max three years).

opportunities.title: Beatrice de Cardi Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Requires two references. Part of the Research and Travel Grants programme; applications from project director or principal investigator; not for degree work; no retrospective applications.
opportunities.summary: Named research award supporting archaeological research (historically focused on Arabian/Persian Gulf archaeology), awarded as part of the Society's Research and Travel Grants programme with a 7 April annual deadline.

opportunities.title: Janet Arnold Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Part of the Research and Travel Grants programme; applications from project director or principal investigator; not for degree work; no retrospective applications.
opportunities.summary: Named research award supporting research into dress and textiles, awarded as part of the Society's Research and Travel Grants programme with a 7 April annual deadline.

opportunities.title: Tessa and Mortimer Wheeler Travel Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Part of the Research and Travel Grants programme; travel award with reduced reporting requirements; applications from project director or principal investigator.
opportunities.summary: Travel award supporting archaeological fieldwork and travel, awarded as part of the Society's Research and Travel Grants programme with a 7 April annual deadline.

opportunities.title: William Lambarde Travel Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Part of the Research and Travel Grants programme; travel award with reduced reporting requirements; applicants who require funds primarily for their own research travel should consider applying for a Lambarde Travel Award.
opportunities.summary: Travel award for researchers primarily needing funds for their own research travel, awarded as part of the Society's Research and Travel Grants programme with a 7 April annual deadline.

opportunities.title: William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: No references required. Supporting documents such as photographs, architect/conservation reports or budgets must be uploaded. Applied via the Grants Application Portal under 'William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants'.
opportunities.summary: Conservation grants for church conservation projects, with two application rounds each year (31 March and 31 August).

opportunities.title: Linda Parry Textile Conservation and Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: No references required. Applicants apply via the Grants Application Portal by selecting 'William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants' form.
opportunities.summary: Textile conservation and research grants, applied for via the William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants application form, with two application rounds each year (31 March and 31 August).
